column_description: Description of the data, e.g. clinical_supplement, aligned_reads
UUID that all versions of the data (in other words, all GUIDs) point to
128-bit hash value expressed as a 32 digit hexadecimal number (in lower case) used as a file's digital fingerprint
Access Control List -- if access is controlled, this field contains the dbGaP accession, eg phs000179
Reason for removal from the GDC
ID of the Project -- e.g. TCGA-BRCA, TARGET-AML, etc.
File state -- either submitted or released
Name of file at the GDC
